title: Notch device HUD
brief: Notch HUD for any Bluetooth or USB device connecting or disconnecting (AirPods, headsets, mice, keyboards, trackpads, game controllers, unknown devices): device icon by type, name, battery when reported (AirPods Left, Right and Case), an intentional Connected state without battery, gray Disconnected, amber and red low-battery warnings, and charging, on MacBook camera notches and external displays, transient and click-through

artboards.title: Device wings
artboards.tradeoff: Same wings as volume and Focus, never covers the window; long names wrap to two small lines and AirPods get three short numbers with no per-part bar

artboards.title: Wings plus Devices drawer
artboards.tradeoff: Batteries checkable any time from the hover drawer, low devices first; adds a tab to the 180 pt drawer, depends on how fresh macOS levels are, and needs background tracking

artboards.title: Drop card
artboards.tradeoff: Clearest read of multi-battery devices with one ring per part; covers the top 100 pt of the window for 3 s and adds a second HUD shape
